description: List of dams, water tanks and ponds under the responsability of the Jordan Valley Authority - WAJ database, Jordan, 2017 is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Water Authority of Jordan, Claudio Zucca. The dataset was provided by the Dam Department of the Water Authority of Jordan (WAJ). The database was originally in Arab and was translated in english in order to be compared with other datasets. The database enlists 363 sites related to Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) interventions, divided in three categories: dams, tanks and ponds. Coverage: national (JO); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the Dataverse metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
